webhooks.detail: HTTP push webhooks for create/update/remove on Issues, Comments, Projects, Cycles, Documents, Initiatives, Users, etc.; plus Issue SLA and OAuthApp revoked events. Admin or admin-scope OAuth required.

evidence.quote: Linear provides webhooks which allow you to receive HTTP push notifications whenever data is created, updated or removed.

sandbox.detail: No dedicated sandbox, but Free plan workspace includes API and webhook access, usable for testing integrations.

rate_limits.summary: API key 2,500 req/hr per user; OAuth app 5,000 req/hr; complexity cap 10,000 pts/query (3M/hr API key); 429 + Retry-After

evidence.quote: When authenticated using an API key you can make up to 2,500 requests per hour.
It’s written in Typescript but can also be used in any Javascript environment.
It supports introspection so you can query the whole schema.
